turns.prompt: when I end a meeting, the recap leaves out any task that has a person on it but no deadline. like if they say 'Priya will send the contract' with no date it just isnt in the action items. can you fix it
turns.final_message:
I fixed it. The cause was the prompts: no code was filtering these tasks out. The meeting-end recap prompts never told the model to keep a task that has a person but no date, and the Groq prompt's only example (`"Bob: Draft invite copy by Wednesday"`) made it look like a date was required. So the model dropped things like "Priya will send the contract".

I haven't run a meeting to check the result. I also couldn't run the TypeScript check, because it needed to download from the npm registry and that was blocked here. All the changes are to text inside prompt strings.

**What I changed:**
- **`electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`**: added a rule to the shared rules used by both the default recap and the mode-specific recaps. Any task with an owner is kept, a missing date is never a reason to drop it, and the model writes `(no date given)` instead of making up a date. I also changed the `actionItems` description to ask for `Owner: task` with a date or `(no date given)`.
- **`electron/llm/prompts.ts`** (`GROQ_SUMMARY_JSON_PROMPT`): added the same rule and a second example with no date: `"Priya: Send the contract (no date given)"`.
- **`electron/llm/tinyPrompts.ts`**: added the same rule to the small-model recap prompt. The team-meeting live format was `[Who] to [What] by [When]`, so tasks without a date are now kept there too, with `(no date given)`.

So "Priya will send the contract" should now show up as **Priya: Send the contract (no date given)**.

**A separate problem I noticed:** the Groq recap prompt asks for a `summary` key, but the meeting screen reads `overview`. When the recap comes from Groq, the overview text probably won't show. I left it alone; I can fix it if you want.

I made a second round of fixes. I still haven't reproduced the problem or run a meeting, so I can't confirm it's fixed. After the first round I checked the code after the model replies (saving, loading and display) and none of it removes items. So the cause has to be in what the model is asked for or what it sees, and I found two more gaps there.

**1. Some modes only listed your own tasks.** In Sales, Recruiting and Team Meet, the "Action Items" section was defined as "action items that I have to do". So "Priya will send the contract" was left out because Priya isn't you. My first fix didn't cover this. Changes:
- `electron/services/ModesManager.ts`: those three section descriptions now ask for every task, with the person's name in front and the date if one was given.
- `electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`: the mode recap prompt now says to list every task that has a person on it, whoever that person is, with or without a date. This part matters because modes you already created keep their own saved copy of the old descriptions, so the template change alone won't reach them.

**2. Long meetings were cut off.** The model only saw the first 10,000 characters of the transcript, about 10–15 minutes of talk. Tasks mentioned after that never reached it. I raised the limit to 48,000 characters, which is still well within what Groq and Gemini can take.

If it still drops tasks, please tell me:
- which mode was active
- which AI provider you use
- the transcript line that got missed

Then check the app log for the line `[MeetingPersistence] Raw LLM summary response`. It shows whether the model never returned the task or something went wrong after that.

I've done a third round of fixes, but I haven't been able to reproduce the problem. Three rounds of guessing hasn't fixed it for you, so I think we need to see the actual model output.

**What I fixed this time (long meetings only):** after about 1,800 transcript lines, the app replaces the oldest 500 lines with a short summary. The end-of-meeting recap then sees that summary, not the original words. That summary prompt never mentioned action items, and the code cut each summary to 5 bullets. So in long meetings, early tasks were lost before the final recap ran.
- `electron/SessionTracker.ts`: the summary prompt now asks for every task as its own bullet, with `(no date given)` when there's no date.
- `electron/llm/RecapLLM.ts`: the 5-bullet limit is now adjustable. These in-meeting summaries allow up to 25 bullets; every other recap still uses 5.

This fix does nothing for a normal-length meeting. I've now looked at the whole end-of-meeting path (from the Stop button through to the meeting screen) and nothing in the code deletes action items. Whatever is still going wrong is in what the model sends back.

**Why I can't test it here:** the project's dependencies aren't installed, npm downloads are blocked, and there's no AI provider key, so I can't build or run the recap. None of the three rounds has been type-checked or tested.

**To find the real cause, I need one failing meeting:**
1. **The app log:** after ending the meeting, find the line starting `[MeetingPersistence] Raw LLM summary response` and the `Active mode:` line just before it. Those show what the model returned and which prompt it got.
2. **Which provider** answered: the log line `✅ ... summary generated successfully` names it.
3. **How you're running the app:** did you rebuild after my changes (`npm run app:dev` or a new build)? An older build would still use the old prompts.

With the log line I can tell whether the model never wrote the task, or whether something after it is dropping it.
